evidence.title: True IDC Pushes Security Economy, Breaking Ground on Mega Data Center in EEC with 77-Billion-Baht BOI Investment, Cementing Thailand's No. 1 Position
evidence.excerpt: True IDC reports breaking ground on a new AI Hyperscale mega data center in Thailand's Eastern Economic Corridor.
